name: TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD.
summary: TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD. engages in the funeral services business in Taiwan. It also offers cleaning services, as well as engages in rental, e-commerce, and cultural and creative businesses. TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD. was formerly known as DataFab Systems Inc. and changed its name to TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD. in July 2015. TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD. was founded in 1982 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
